en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Abu Al Jaroud who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> used to wear the dyed and the radiant (clothes)’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from abu al-Jarud who has said the following: “
Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would wear al-Mu‘asfar (dye with safflower) clothes and printed clothes.”
